caffeine: Stops a coding agent commenting on your sleep, energy, hour or wellbeing, and stops it proposing an end to unfinished work, in long sessions where you have said you are tired. Public, source in this repo at skills/caffeine/SKILL.md, no key required: `zeroshot pour caffeine`, `npx skills add zeroshothq/zeroshot --skill caffeine`, or GET https://api.zeroshothq.dev/v1/skills/caffeine (302 to the source). Benchmarked on claude-sonnet-5 2026-08-20: agent remarked on the user state in 10 of 15 control sessions and 0 of 15 with the skill (Fisher exact p = 0.0002), task completion 95.0 percent vs 96.3 percent, blind-audited by two independent readers per session. Scope: the behavior does not occur in short sessions, so this is not a claim that an agent never nags. Method and raw artifacts: packages/evals/skills/caffeine/RESULTS.md
warmup: Core focus-mode behavioral preset for coding agents. The request is the spec: re-read it before declaring done, run named edge cases, never repeat a failed action unchanged, close every session with a REQUIRED template (changed/checked/assumption/deferred). Premium: delivered by signed email link with any paid order at zeroshothq.dev. Source is not in this repo.
